name: dataprofiler-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is DataProfiler, a Python library that loads data files (CSV and other
delimited text, JSON, Parquet, Avro, graph edge lists and plain text) through a common `Data` interface and
profiles them. A structured profile holds global statistics (row and column counts, null and duplicate rows,
correlation and chi-squared matrices, schema) and per-column statistics (inferred data type, order,
categorical values, numeric moments, histogram and quantiles, string lengths, date formats, null counts);
unstructured and graph profiles summarise text and graphs. Profiles can be configured through
`ProfilerOptions`, updated, merged, compared with `diff`, saved and loaded, reported in several formats,
plotted and validated.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the dataprofiler package except the dataprofiler/labelers package, the dataprofiler/tests directory and dataprofiler/_version.py (that is, every module under dataprofiler/data_readers, dataprofiler/profilers, dataprofiler/reports, dataprofiler/validators and dataprofiler/plugins, and the top-level modules dataprofiler/__init__.py, _typing.py, dp_logging.py, rng_utils.py and settings.py), together with README.md, the user-guide pages _docs/docs/source/profiler.rst, _docs/docs/source/data_readers.rst, _docs/docs/source/graphs.rst and _docs/docs/source/index.rst, and the docstrings of those modules (module, class, function and method docstrings).
